Minimum 3-5 years operational/administrative support. Experience in recruitment and employment policies, procedures, and laws, and skills to to be an effective resource to hiring managers.

Five years’ experience working in a highly-confidential environment including maintaining confidentiality of Executive Office and Human Resources activities and records. Experience with Aggie Enterprise, Aggie Expense, Aggie Travel, UCPath, AUSS-C.

Reporting to the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), provide operational support to the Director and the CAO for the Center for Neuroscience (CNS). Supervise the CNS student Team and manage CNS business office needs. Under general direction of the CAO, responsible for coordinating all CNS personnel and employment activities and informs faculty, supervisors and staff on human resources and employment policies and procedures. This position prepares academic actions including appointments, merits, promotions, appraisals, recruitment, for CNS Academic Federation titles. This position provides administrative support for the recruitment process for academic personnel, career staff and student assistant positions.
The position works 100% live onsite with a flexible schedule to accommodate CNS events.
Familiarity with University policies and procedures.
Organizational and time management skills to manage multiple tasks, prioritize and organize workload, meet deadlines and perform assigned duties with minimal supervision.
Knowledge of academic and staff personnel policies including collective bargaining unit agreements.
Skills to problem solve, review, research and analyze within each of the functional areas.
Skills to function independently and creatively to research, analyze and coordinate a variety of administrative projects with general guidance and review by supervisory personnel.
Interpersonal and communication skills to work as part of a team with a wide variety of faculty, staff, and external sponsors.
Skills and ability to follow projects to completion, keeping appropriate personnel advised of project status, due dates, etc.
